purpose: Overall requirements of the doc-link plugin replacing DocAdvisor: goals, scope, glossary, non-functional requirements, error cases, and the decision and open-item registers.
summary: Purpose and background: replace path-based DocAdvisor with permanent document ID management
System-wide flow of setup, DLID check and assignment, reference check, ToC build, and impact check
Document search flow with ToC rebuild confirmation and the stale ToC warning
Glossary of terms such as DLID, document ID, section ID, ToC, content hash, and project management AI
Scope: included and excluded items, and responsibility boundary between doc-link and the project management AI
Write boundary: doc-link may write only DLIDs into target documents
Non-functional requirements: reproducibility, determinism, idempotence, diagnosability, resumability, scalability, separation of generation limit and validation limit
Error candidates and findings that do not block ToC commit
Decision register D-001 to D-059 covering IDs, references, hashing, search policy, and operation flow
tasks: Understanding the overall goals and scope of doc-link
Looking up a decision by its D number
Checking glossary term definitions before writing specifications
Designing or implementing DLID assignment and write-boundary verification
Designing the operation flow of index, link check, and impact check
Reviewing non-functional requirements and error handling
Resolving conflicts between requirements and design
title: doc-link 要件定義書 — 総論
